weather_report:
Osborne Park is wrapped in a clean, generous blue this late morning, the light crisp and sure of itself, shadows sharp, edges clarified. The day feels open and uncomplicated, as if the windows of the world have just been wiped down, inviting a steady, unhurried pace.

Clear skies are set to hold through the afternoon into early evening, so the sunshine will stay abundant and the view uncluttered. The spring sun has a bit of bite now—expect the UV to run high around midday—so dress in light layers with a brimmed hat and sunglasses, and give the sunscreen some work to do. It’s a good day for the ordinary pleasures: walking to the shops, hanging the washing, tending a few pots, taking lunch at a shaded table, or a gentle spin to a nearby errand once the light softens. The day should end with that calm, honeyed glow that makes you linger on the way home.
